goal: Show one original adult identity across six clearly differentiated realistic wardrobe capsules.
audience: Fashion editors and wardrobe teams reviewing a compact seasonal lookbook

content.subject: The same fictional adult woman repeated across exactly six full-body fashion cells
must_include: Exactly six depictions of one adult identity

art_direction.lighting: Soft neutral studio window light with restrained floor shadows

composition.layout: Clean two-column by three-row catalog grid with equal figure scale and aligned floor lines
composition.viewpoint: Natural full-body 65 mm fashion catalog perspective

objective_checks: Exactly six full-body figures are visible
No text, logo, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Face, hair, skin tone, age, and body proportions remain consistent
Hands and shoes are plausible and complete
The result reads as photography rather than illustration or 3D
